name: Bug report
about: Something in Immuch360 does not work (360° viewer, 360° videos, Library entry, Meta Quest view)
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Device and build**
Phone or headset model, Android or iOS version, Immuch360 build (Settings, About, or the release tag), Immich server version.

**What happens**
Steps, what you expected, what you got. For the Meta Quest view, the output of `adb logcat -d -v time -s Immuch360` helps a lot (remove your server address from it first).

**The media**
Camera model and app used to export, resolution, photo or video, codec if you know it.
